scope: Apple HIG source review and native simulator observation; proposed fixes only

simulation.harness: Private staged Debug observation harness; not applied to production source or repository UI tests
simulation.command_template: xcodebuild test -project GlassImageTools.xcodeproj -scheme GlassImageTools -destination "platform=visionOS Simulator,id=<local-simulator>" -parallel-testing-enabled NO -only-testing:GlassImageToolsUITests/HIGReviewObservationTests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
simulation.command_reproducibility_limit: The observation class and initial-size/long-name fixture adaptations were private to the staging copy. Reproduce visible findings with the manual steps in HIG_REVIEW.md; this class is not a checked-in test target.

variants.long_name: Neutral synthetic filename of approximately 190 ASCII characters, including extension

measurements.frame_selection: Matched content and toolbar windows from AX hierarchy; firstMatch XR host dimensions excluded

observed.compact_long_title_largest_text: Document action row and source metadata visually absent/clipped despite AX presence
observed.compact_annotation_toolbar: Wider than content window; commands still visually available
observed.pan_enabled_at_225_percent: Closed menu shows magnifier/225% without persistent Pan cue; open menu shows checked Pan
observed.selected_pixelation_options: Popover obscures a substantial portion of selected region
observed.appearance_endpoints: Transparent/Opaque wrap into narrow word fragments at default size/text

findings.evidence: Source concern; direct hardware outcome unobserved

limits: No physical-device calls or new deployment in this task
No new accessibility .all audit executed; earlier recorded results retain their scope
No new encoded-pixel, clipboard-recipient, capture or hardware-resource acceptance
Gaze/hover, assistive-technology speech/focus, keyboard and icon lighting/motion remain hardware checks
Raw logs, compositor images and private configuration remain local

documentation_checks.scope: Changed review/navigation records; pattern check is not a guarantee against all sensitive content
